main_text.p: (rurfum terminum)ufque mane, quafi leo fic conterebat omnia ossa[?] mea:à die ufque ad noftem confummabis me.Sicut grus & hirundo fic garriebam,meditabar ficut columba:fublati erant oculi mei in excelfum. Domine, opprimit me (languor meus) refrigera me. Quid dicam? & dixit mihi,qui & ipfe fecit: mouebor igitur cunctis annis meis fuper hac amaritudine animæ meæ. Domine,ultra eos uiuent: & omnibus(hominibus narrabo)quod in ipfis (annis habeam) uitam fpiritus mei, & quod tu me dormire feceris,atq; reuificaueris me. Ecce pro ualetudine(habenda) fuit mihi amara amaritudo: & tibi complacitum fuit (eripere) animam meam à putrida fouea: quoniam proiecifti poft tergum tuum omnia peccata mea. Quoniam infernus nō confitebitur tibi,(neque) mors laudabit te, nec expectabunt qui defcedunt in foueam (ut enarrent) ueritatem tuam.'Viuens vi-uens ipfe confitebitur tibi,ficut ego hodie: & pater filijs indicabit ueritate tuam. Domini eft,ut faluet me, & cantica mea cantabimus cunctis diebus uitæ noftrę in domo Domini. Et ait Iefaiahu:Accipiant maffam ficorum,& adhibeant ulceri,& coualefcet.

page.notes: Page type is text, one column. The catchword "Dixitq;" is set below the last line and is therefore not repeated in the text. The apostrophe before "Viuens" is printed and was kept as it stands. The word printed as "ofla" is read as "ossa" with doubt. The hyphenated line-end word "ui-uens" was written as "vi-uens" with the printed hyphen kept. The running text runs straight on with no indented paragraph breaks visible, so it is one paragraph. The first word fragment "(rurfum terminum)ufque" continues from the previous page.
